words.definition: an unintended escape of liquid, gas, or information
words.example: Maintenance is checking the pipe for a possible leak.
words.exampleTranslation: 維修人員正在檢查管線是否有漏水。
words.note: 同形詞：也可作動詞，指「洩漏」，例如 Information leaked to the press。

words.definition: the state of using or living in a building or room
words.example: The hotel reported high occupancy during the holiday season.
words.exampleTranslation: 這間飯店在假期期間的入住率很高。
words.note: 動詞形：occupy (v.) 佔用；居住，例如 The room is occupied by a guest。

words.definition: a high degree of skill or competence
words.example: The job requires proficiency in at least two languages.
words.exampleTranslation: 這份工作要求至少精通兩種語言。
words.note: 形容詞形：proficient (adj.) 熟練的，例如 She is proficient in Excel。

words.definition: the act of extending the validity of something, such as a contract
words.example: The lease renewal must be signed before the end of the month.
words.exampleTranslation: 租約續約必須在月底前簽署。
words.note: 動詞形：renew (v.) 更新；續約，例如 Please renew your membership before it expires。

words.definition: requiring immediate action or attention
words.example: This is an urgent request, so please respond by noon.
words.exampleTranslation: 這是緊急請求，請在中午前回覆。
words.note: 副詞形：urgently (adv.) 緊急地，例如 We urgently need your reply。

words.definition: once a year; every year
words.example: The conference is held annually in a different city.
words.exampleTranslation: 這場研討會每年在不同城市舉行一次。
words.note: 同義詞 yearly，相關詞：annual (adj.) 每年的，例如 an annual report。

words.definition: a team sport played by throwing a ball through a hoop
words.example: The company sponsors a basketball tournament for local schools.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司贊助了一場給當地學校的籃球賽。
words.note: 當運動名稱時不可數，當實體「籃球」時可數，例如 pass me the basketball。

words.definition: to remove something, especially from a computer file
words.example: Please delete any outdated files from the shared drive.
words.exampleTranslation: 請把共用硬碟裡過時的檔案刪除。
words.note: 名詞形：deletion (n.) 刪除，例如 The deletion was accidental。

words.definition: not sensible or reasonable
words.example: It seems illogical to cancel the project this close to launch.
words.exampleTranslation: 在這麼接近上線的時候取消專案似乎不合邏輯。
words.note: 否定字首 il-（用於 l 開頭的字）+ logical = illogical

words.definition: an animal kept for companionship
words.example: The office recently introduced a pet-friendly policy.
words.exampleTranslation: 辦公室最近推出了寵物友善政策。
words.note: 也可作動詞，指「撫摸」，例如 pet the cat（過去式雙寫子音為 petted）

words.definition: a book used for studying a subject
words.example: New employees receive a training textbook during orientation.
words.exampleTranslation: 新進員工在職前訓練時會收到一本訓練教材。
words.note: 常用片語 a textbook example（典型範例）

words.definition: in a way that is correct and precise
words.example: Please fill out the form accurately to avoid delays.
words.exampleTranslation: 請準確填寫表格以避免延誤。
words.note: 名詞形：accuracy (n.) 準確度，例如 Check the data for accuracy。

words.definition: a small wooden house, or the passenger area of an aircraft
words.example: Flight attendants will ask passengers to fasten their seatbelts before the cabin doors close.
words.exampleTranslation: 機艙門關閉前，空服員會請乘客繫好安全帶。
words.note: 常見於 cabin crew（機艙組員）這個複合詞

words.definition: a person who leads an orchestra, or an official on a train
words.example: The train conductor announced a delay due to signal problems.
words.exampleTranslation: 列車車掌宣布因為號誌問題而誤點。
words.note: 動詞形：conduct (v.) 指揮；進行，例如 conduct a meeting（主持會議）。

words.definition: a person who officially examines something to check its quality or safety
words.example: A safety inspector will visit the factory next week.
words.exampleTranslation: 一位安全檢查員下週會來工廠訪查。
words.note: 動詞形：inspect (v.) 檢查，例如 inspect the equipment before use。

words.definition: a student or trainee who works, sometimes without pay, to gain experience
words.example: The marketing team hired two interns for the summer.
words.exampleTranslation: 行銷團隊雇用了兩名暑期實習生。
words.note: 名詞形：internship (n.) 實習，例如 apply for a summer internship。

words.definition: half of an academic year
words.example: The training program runs for one semester.
words.exampleTranslation: 這個訓練課程為期一個學期。
words.note: 美式英語用 semester，英式英語通常用 term

words.definition: a statement or document that proves something is true or agreed
words.example: You will receive a confirmation email once your order ships.
words.exampleTranslation: 訂單出貨後你會收到一封確認信。
words.note: 動詞形：confirm (v.) 確認，例如 Please confirm your attendance。

words.definition: an expression of praise for someone's achievement or success
words.example: Please accept our congratulations on your promotion.
words.exampleTranslation: 請接受我們對你升遷的祝賀。
words.note: 通常用複數形 congratulations，例如 Congratulations on your promotion!

words.definition: expert skill or knowledge in a particular field
words.example: We need someone with expertise in international tax law.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們需要在國際稅法方面有專業知識的人。
words.note: 不可數名詞，沒有複數形 expertises
